description: Purpose: fetch one full record from the fitness safety-boundary domain by stable id - an exercise, a condition, or an exercise x condition safety boundary - including every citation as a verbatim quote plus its section locator, retrieval timestamp, source content hash and the record's own content hash, so a downstream agent can cite and verify it without re-fetching. Guidelines: get the id from query_safety_boundaries first (or pass name as a keyword when the match is unambiguous); set include_domain_contract=true to also receive the domain contract (id prefixes, required fields, assertion-kind semantics, source-verification summary, hard boundaries). Every record carries assertion_kind - 'explicit' means the source states the conclusion in plain terms, 'derived' means it was inferred from explicit source facts and the reasoning chain is given. Limits: **no individualised advice** and no diagnosis; paid standards / copyrighted books are metadata only; records without source support are not held here at all. Ex: get_fitness_record(id='fit-ex-back-squat'), get_fitness_record(id='fit-ci-machine-resistance-training-vertebral-fracture-risk'), get_fitness_record(name='卷腹', include_domain_contract=true, language='en').

id.description: 记录稳定 id：fit-ex-* / fit-cond-* / fit-ci-*

include_domain_contract.description: 同时返回领域契约（id 前缀 / 必填字段 / assertion_kind 语义 / 来源核实结论 / 硬边界）

kind.description: 限定记录类型（配合 name 使用时更精确）

name.description: 名称关键词（中英皆可）；命中多条时返回候选 id 列表

name: get_fitness_record

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
